scope: One owned JBL Bar 9.1, Go web service with auto_standard and smart_mode_memory, over existing root SSH; no firmware flash. Times are remote.log timestamps (one-second sampling); power was switched with the bar's own controls.

cases.result: Standard before standby, Smart kept after wake: wrong
cases.finding: The firmware switched to Smart about 25 s before it reported standby after the power button; five samples took that for a choice.

cases.result: Smart remembered in smart-mode.json across a service restart: wake completed without a gesture
Standard selected from the page was remembered

cases.note: Standby 14 s after the previous wake: the firmware's Smart before standby was not remembered.

observations: remote.log showed a 2016 timestamp before the first final-build wake: the service started before the bar's clock was set; smart-mode.json was read correctly.
Not yet recorded with the final build: Smart selected from the page, then standby and wake (the Smart-kept wake above used a Smart record from the first build).
